senses.gloss:
m. (-लिः)
1 Weariness, fatigue.
2 Loss, destruction.
3 End, term.
4 Equality, sameness.
5 A bracelet.
E.
ला to take, or ली to melt, &c., aff. कि.

r. 4th cl. (लीयते) r. 9th cl. (लिनाति)
1 To join, to adhere or cling to, to be in union or connexion with.
2 To obtain.
r. 10th cl. (लयति लाययति लापयति लालयति or लीनयति)
To melt, to liquefy, to fuse or dissolve.
With आङ्,
To waste away.
With प्र and वि,
To acquire or gain.

f. (-लीः)
Embracing.
E.
ली to embrace, क्विप् aff.
